evidence.detail: PD.initMenu registers only hamburger-click and scrim-click handlers; no keydown/keyup listener for Escape exists anywhere in the file
The nav menu template has no close/X button element
No results — Escape key dismissal is entirely absent

triage.fix_sketch: In shared_web/static/js/pd.js: add a document keydown listener that calls the same close logic as the scrim click handler when e.key === 'Escape' (~5 lines, inside PD.initMenu). Optionally add a close/X button to decksite/templates/menu.mustache (1 line) and style it in pd.css (~10 lines). Total ~20-30 lines across 2-3 files.
triage.notes: The issue also shows a screenshot requesting an explicit dismiss button with an X icon; implementing Esc alone is a minimum fix. Adding the button is a small additive change.
